description: This file defines the ModuleDictImpl class, a container for managing a collection of neural network modules in PyTorch, including methods for iteration, access, modification, and cloning of modules.

classes.name: ModuleDictImpl
classes.description: A container class for managing a collection of modules with key-value pairs, supporting iteration, access, update, and cloning functionalities.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns all key-module pairs in the container.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all keys in the container.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns all module values in the container.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the container.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the container.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of modules stored.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the container is empty.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the container.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all modules from the container.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ModuleDict, optionally on a specified device.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Empty method, does not reset parameters.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of the ModuleDict.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a module by key, throws if key not found.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Returns a reference to a module cast to a specific type, throws if cast fails.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns a module by key.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the container with key-module pairs from a vector or other container.
